job.name: l4_board_a
job.meaning: дизайн-система ролика «Быстро — продукты за 60 минут» на основе всего брендбука «Тёмный продукт» (первый референс) с нашим ведущим (второй референс) и 6 раскладками вертикальных кадров; вариант A «Неоновое стекло»: максимально близко к борду — тёмный фон, полупрозрачные стеклянные карточки, неоновые циан/фиолетовые кольца и подиумы под продуктом, мягкие свечения
job.prompt: Create a complete design system board (brand style guide sheet) for SHORT VERTICAL 9:16 product advertising videos. The FIRST attached image is the approved brand board «Тёмный продукт» — take the WHOLE brand book from it: palette (near-black #0B0D17, deep navy #141A33, neon cyan #3BE8FF, violet #8B5CF6, soft white #EEF2FF), typography (Space Grotesk headlines, Manrope body), its icon style, glass panels, neon glows, decorative elements and principles — and keep the same block structure (hero, colour palette with HEX, typography, presenter style, graphic elements, icons, infographic examples, decorative elements, footer principles). The SECOND attached image is our presenter: use EXACTLY this man (same face, short dark-brown hair, black zip-up tech jacket) everywhere on the board instead of the woman on the first board. The product is a fictional grocery delivery service «Быстро» (delivery in 60 minutes) — replace the headphones with it: a smartphone app with a map and a courier dot, a paper grocery bag, a timer. All text in Russian, short and correctly spelled. Hero title: «Быстро — продукты за 60 минут». IMPORTANT: a block «ВЕРТИКАЛЬНЫЕ КАДРЫ 9:16» with 6 phone-shaped frames showing SIX DIFFERENT LAYOUTS of this video: (1) hook without the presenter: an open EMPTY fridge glowing in the dark and a big timer «60:00» on top; (2) presenter full frame with the logo «Быстро» flashing above his head; (3) the product hero: a big smartphone with the app (map, route, courier dot) in the centre and feature chips around it «60 мин», «0 ₽ от 1 000 ₽», «курьер на карте»; (4) split «Было / Стало»: top half grey and dull «очереди, пакеты, пробки», bottom half neon «3 касания»; (5) presenter's face in a glowing circle with three audience chips «занятым», «мамам», «всем, кому дорог вечер»; (6) call to action: a grocery bag at a door, a neon button «Скачать «Быстро»» and the timer stopped. Every frame has a subtitle bar at the bottom. No real brand names or logos. VARIANT A «Неоновое стекло»: faithful to the brand board — near-black backgrounds, frosted glassmorphism cards with thin glowing borders, neon cyan/violet rings and glowing podiums under the product, soft bloom glows, floating particles. Mood: premium, sleek, Apple-keynote-like.
